data.narrative:
Cognichip is a Series A-stage semiconductor company that has raised $93M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private peers in Chips & Semiconductors (including Rebellions, d-Matrix, and Positron AI) and 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $93M total raised as a proxy for post-Series A step-up, implying $186M. Peer-Median benchmarks Cognichip against three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps: Rebellions ($2.3B Series A), d-Matrix ($2.0B Series A), and Positron AI ($1.0B Series B). The median across this set is $2.0B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because Cognichip's revenue is not on file, and private companies rarely disclose this metric. The median P/S multiple for public semiconductors is 18.9x, but remains non-actionable without revenue data.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $158M to $2.3B, with a median of $1.1B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around whether Cognichip's stage and capital efficiency align more closely with earlier-stage private benchmarks or with established Series A peers commanding higher multiples. Revenue visibility and near-term milestones would meaningfully narrow this range.
